an5.111:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato kulūpago bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:1.3: asanthutavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, viyatthupasevīca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca.
an5.111:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulūpago bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato kulūpago bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.111:2.3: na asanthutavissāsī ca hoti, na anissaravikappī ca, na viyatthupasevīca, na upakaṇṇakajappī ca, na atiyācanako ca.
an5.111:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kulūpago bhikkhu kulesu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cāti.
